story.headline: One system to run all of Halo.
story.intro: Halo brings every part of the studio into one system: the schedule, the studio floor, the waitlist, clients and their packs, instructors, payments and reports, with an AI front desk that answers bookings day and night. It is configured around Halo's own classes, packs and rules. One record follows each client from their first class to their next pack.

ambition.title: Built for where Halo is going
ambition.text: Halo is full in the evenings and turning people away. The system is designed to turn that demand into revenue: fill every freed spot, keep regulars renewing, and show what a seventh day would be worth.

pillars.title: Fill every spot
pillars.text: A freed reformer goes to the next person waiting within a minute, without a phone call.

pillars.title: Keep regulars
pillars.text: Packs are renewed before they run out, and a regular who stops coming is noticed in a week, not a quarter.

pillars.title: Grow on evidence
pillars.text: The waitlist shows exactly which classes to add, and the reports show what they earned.

changes.today: Evening classes sell out and people who cancel late leave a reformer empty.
changes.with: A live waitlist that offers a freed spot to the next person automatically, with a time limit to reply.
changes.means: Fuller evenings without anyone at the desk chasing people.

changes.today: Bookings arrive by WhatsApp, Instagram and phone, and someone types them into a calendar.
changes.with: One schedule that bookings land in directly, from the website, WhatsApp and the AI front desk.
changes.means: No double bookings, and no evenings spent copying messages.

changes.today: Packs run out at the door, and expired ones are only noticed when a client stops coming.
changes.with: Sessions left on every file, renewal offers sent before the last session, and a list of who has gone quiet.
changes.means: Renewals happen on time, and fewer regulars drift away.

changes.today: Instructor hours and cover are worked out on a group chat.
changes.with: A roster with hours per instructor and every class without one, days ahead.
changes.means: No class taught by whoever answered last, and payroll from the same record.

changes.today: Nobody knows what a Sunday, or a new 7pm, would actually fill.
changes.with: Waitlist demand by class, and fill by week, produced from the bookings already recorded.
changes.means: The next class is added on evidence, not a hunch.

story.principles_title: Built around what matters to a studio

principles.title: Instructors see their classes, not the money
principles.text: Roles decide what opens. An instructor sees who is booked, never a client's card or pack payments.

principles.title: Every change is recorded
principles.text: Who booked, cancelled, offered or refunded, and when. Blocked attempts are logged too.

principles.title: The AI books inside your rules
principles.text: It uses the prices, cancellation window and pack rules you set. Where a rule is missing, it asks you rather than guessing.

principles.title: Your data stays yours
principles.text: Exportable in full at any time. Nothing is used to train AI models.

principles.title: Nothing is sent without consent
principles.text: Waitlist offers, reminders and renewal messages only go to clients who agreed to them.

principles.title: Works at the door
principles.text: The studio floor and check-in run on a phone or tablet, so the desk is not a computer.
